question: What is the average area of the windmills in square meters, given a GSD of 0.863?
final_answer_preview:
The average area of the windmills in the image, calculated using the provided Ground Sample Distance (GSD) of 0.863 meters per pixel, is **93.84 square meters**.

This value was derived by analyzing the segmentation results and applying the GSD to convert pixel dimensions into real-world measurements.
